_about: Real raw ConPTY output (Windows 11, PS 5.1 host, 80x24) of Claude Code 2.1.303 (its default view), Codex 0.153.4 and Antigravity CLI 1.4.2, from the submit review of fix/swarm154 (N1, W1-1), with Enter blocked so nothing was sent. A prompt (ALPHA) was typed into the input box, then 40 Left arrows put the cursor inside it; submit then wrote twenty Ctrl+U three times, the first deleting only what was in front of the cursor and the next two nothing, and typed the task in front of what was left. held is the box before the first write, cleared the box after the last, typed the task typed, before Enter; cursor is a task of one line, cursortall one of 30 lines, taller than the box, so only its end shows. raw is what readOutput(terminalId, 1000) returned then, cut to the shortest end of it that draws the same screen; text is what was typed into the box (the held prompt, or the task). Personal strings are replaced by ones of equal length.
